arStrings.szText: Empower your next throw by {c_number}[{SF_13} * 100|%|]{/c} damage per stack.
Increases your armor and block chance per hit of Blessed Shield for 6 seconds.

{c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} detonates {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c} and ricochets {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} additional times.

Whenever, {c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} detonates {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c}, it empowers your next throw to deal {c_number}[{SF_13} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage, up to a maximum of {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} times.

{c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} now boomerangs and pierces instead of ricocheting, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_B_IMPACT}{/c} damage. 

Hitting enemies with {c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} increases its damage by {c_number}[{SF_31}*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}[SF_33]{/c} seconds up to {c_number}{SF_32}{/c} times.

{c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} becomes a {c_important}Juggernaut{/c} Skill.

{c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} travels straight without returning, pulsing your Thorns damage for {c_number}{SF_8}{/c} seconds before bursting for {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_FINAL_DMG}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_34*100|%|]{/c} of your shield's Block Chance as additional damage.

{c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} increases your Armor by {c_number}[{SF_26}*100|%+|]{/c} and Block Chance by {c_number}[{SF_27}*100|%+|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_28}{/c} seconds each time it hits an enemy.
When {c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} hits a Crowd Controlled enemy, gain {c_number}{SF_17}{/c} Faith.
